import os,re,subprocess,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
source=Path(sys.argv[1])/"aosp-14.0.0_r1-src/SOURCE.txt"
value=re.search(r"hw248:([^\s,]+?)/aosp-14\.0\.0_r1-art",source.read_text()).group(1)
env=dict(os.environ,LAB_HOME=value,ORBENV="LAB_HOME")
mac_code='import os,hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256(os.environ["LAB_HOME"].encode()).hexdigest())'
p=subprocess.run(["mac","python3","-c",mac_code],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
print(json.dumps({"rc":p.returncode,"expected":hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest(),"stdout":p.stdout,"stderr":p.stderr}))
